verdict.rationale: Helicone's core value prop is automatic logging/observability with cost and usage tracking, backed by community mentions of 'charts and logging' and using it 'mostly for analytics/observability', plus HQL query language and request-query APIs for programmatic access to logged data. However, no evidence pack item explicitly documents a dashboard UI breaking down cost/tokens by model and time period with screenshots or detailed feature descriptions. Missing for 10: explicit dashboard documentation/screenshots showing per-model and per-time-period cost/token breakdowns, and independent hands-on confirmation of these dashboard views.
